title: Metaethical Perspectives on 'Benchmarking' AI Ethics
reasoning: The paper's central thesis is an in-depth philosophical argument about the impossibility of benchmarking AI ethics. It extensively draws upon and analyzes concepts from moral philosophy and metaethics, including moral realism, normative theories like utilitarianism and deontology, and moral dilemmas such as the trolley problem, to build its case. This is not a brief or peripheral discussion but the core subject of the paper.
